name: GS P&L Co., Ltd.
summary: GS P&L Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, operates as a hospitality company in Korea. It operates Parnas Hotel Jeju, a resort-style hotel; Nine Tree by Parnas, a business hotel; Sunflower International Village, a hotel-style residence; and Grand InterContinental Seoul Parnas, a business and cultural center. The company also operates shopping complex under the Parnas Mall name; and office building under the Parnas Tower name. In addition, it processes, produces, and supplies meat products, including pork, beef, imported meat, and seasoned meat; and processes and sells livestock products.
